    operationhours,
    maintenancecyclehours,
    operationalstatus,
    CASE 
        WHEN operationalstatus = 'Active' THEN ROUND(CAST(10 * (1 - operationhours::numeric / maintenancecyclehours::numeric) AS numeric), 2)
        WHEN operationalstatus = 'Standby' THEN ROUND(CAST(5 * (1 - operationhours::numeric / maintenancecyclehours::numeric) AS numeric), 2)
        ELSE 0
    END AS readiness_metric
